findings.claim: Runtime-authoritative phase creation can leave filesystem phase artifacts behind when canonical runtime creation fails, violating the malformed/failure no-mutation postcondition pattern required for phase creation.
findings.evidence: The helper creates the phase directory and writes goals before entering the runtime path: `mkdirSync(phaseDir, { recursive: true }); writeGoals(phaseDir, goals); if (runtimeAuthoritative) { await runtimeAuthorityPath(name); ... }`. Acceptance requires phase creation postconditions to be completed through canonical runtime authority and invalid/failing setup to refuse before creating a phase or mutating state (`Invalid project configuration` scenario; design says validate before mutation and complete shared postconditions after canonical activation).
findings.suggested_fix: In runtime-authoritative mode, perform canonical runtime create/activate/transition before creating local phase files, or roll back `phaseDir`/goals if any canonical runtime step fails.
